test_title: PYST 48: SSC GD Constable 2022 - English (Held On : 31 Jan 2023 Shift 4)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to substitute it, select ‘No substitution’.

When I was young, __I can memorise lessons faster than Mohan.__

options.text: I could memorise lessons faster to Mohan
I could memorise lessons faster than Mohan
I can memorise lessons faster to Mohan

solution:
The correct answer is "**I could memorise lessons faster than Mohan.**"
